toegepas.blok: Energie wat van ver af kom
toegepas.voor: kry die lig teen die kombuis se dak
toegepas.na: kry die lig aan die kombuis se plafon
toegepas.rede_vinder: Indoors a light hangs from the ceiling (plafon); 'dak' is the roof, and 'aan' fits a fitting that hangs better than 'teen'.
toegepas.fout: 'dak' is the roof; a light inside the kitchen is on the ceiling (plafon).
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'aan die kombuis se plafon' is the precise, natural indoor phrase and still only locates the light at the ceiling, so the meaning holds.

toegepas.blok: Energie wat van ver af kom
toegepas.voor: sy energie nie daar naby nie
toegepas.na: sy energie nie van naby af nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'kry ... nie daar naby nie' lacks the source preposition; 'nie van naby af nie' is the natural idiom.
toegepas.fout: 'kry ... sy energie nie daar naby nie' is a stiff location phrase where a source phrase is needed.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'nie van naby af nie' is the natural idiom for where something comes from and says the same thing.

toegepas.blok: Energie wat van ver af kom
toegepas.na: oor 'n pad wat kilometers lank is
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'n pad van kilometers ver' is an awkward construction; a route is described as long, not far.
toegepas.fout: ''n pad van kilometers ver' is an awkward construction.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'n pad wat kilometers lank is' reads naturally and keeps the meaning; the echo with 'lang drade' is mild.

toegepas.blok: Nie elke stasie brand steenkool nie
toegepas.voor: brand niks en die vallende water
toegepas.na: brand niks nie, en die vallende water
toegepas.rede_vinder: Afrikaans needs the closing 'nie' after 'niks' in this clause, and AWS 2017 puts a comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have a subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: The negative clause 'brand niks' lacks its closing 'nie', and the two clauses with their own subjects and verbs lack the AWS comma before 'en'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Adds the required second 'nie' and the AWS comma without changing what the sentence says.

laat_vaar.voor: ver genoeg terug en jy kom
laat_vaar.na: ver genoeg terug, en jy kom
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two complete sentences here (an imperative and 'jy kom ... uit'), so a comma goes before it.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The first clause is an imperative with no subject of its own and the sentence is one tight 'do this and you get that' unit, so the house comma rule does not require a comma.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: As a conjunction introducing a clause, standard written Afrikaans uses 'totdat' rather than 'tot'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'tot' is standard Afrikaans as a conjunction, so 'totdat' is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.blok: Wat die stasie met die steenkool doen
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: In written study text a thing (the machine) is referred to as 'dit', not the colloquial 'hom'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'hom' points unambiguously to the machine, whereas 'dit' could also point back to 'die stoom' in the same sentence.

laat_vaar.blok: Nie elke stasie brand steenkool nie
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: This is the first machine mentioned at the dam station, so the indefinite article fits, as in the block's last sentence and the glossary.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'die masjien' reads naturally as the turning machine the reader has already met, so the article swap is lateral.

vlae.blok: Nie elke stasie brand steenkool nie
vlae.teks: 'n Kernkragstasie brand ook nie steenkool nie en kry sy hitte uit kernkrag.
vlae.rede: 'kernkrag' uses 'krag' where the lesson otherwise insists on 'energie' (see the protected entry for energie/krag), and the sentence explains the station's heat by its own name; changing it to 'kernenergie' would alter a subject term, so this is for the writer or a person to decide, not a language edit.
